summary: Join our Treasury and Cash Management training course tailored for Central Banks. Learn best practices and improve your financial management expertise.
lede: Central bank treasury and cash management helps senior treasury, risk and investment professionals manage liquidity, cash flows and financial risk. Participants work with forecasting, liquidity planning, integrated risk assessment and stress testing, reserve allocation, scenario planning, and performance reporting to support treasury decisions and clear stakeholder communication.
modules: The Strategic Role of Central Bank Treasury Management
Technology and Innovation in Treasury Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a solid foundation in financial management principles and experience in central bank operations.
